task.instruction: Show the scores and main highlight of the Milwaukee Bucks game that took place within the last 2 days on ESPN.

final_answer:
Milwaukee Bucks lost to the Toronto Raptors 121–107 in an NBA Cup Group Play game at Milwaukee (recap filed Nov 7, 2026 — within the last two days, so it's the most recent Bucks game on ESPN).

Scoring by quarter:
- Raptors (TOR): 24 | 27 | 38 | 32 — 121
- Bucks (MIL): 29 | 31 | 27 | 20 — 107

Milwaukee led 60–51 at halftime but was outscored 70–47 after the break, including 32–20 in the fourth quarter. The Bucks fall to 1-8 on the season (1-4 at home), while Toronto moves to 5-4.

Main highlight: Alijah Martin scored a career-high 27 points, and RJ Barrett also had 27 (9/21 FG, 9/11 FT) as a short-handed Raptors team beat the Bucks. ESPN's recap headline reads: "Alijah Martin's career game helps short-handed Raptors beat the Bucks 121-107 in NBA Cup game." Other game leaders: Toronto's Jakob Poeltl and Brayden Burries each grabbed 11 rebounds, and Jamal Shead dished out 16 assists; for Milwaukee, Tyler Herro finished with 23 points (7/16 FG, 8/10 FT) and 10 assists.
